component.name: MyGo Music
component.summary: Music player for your files and more

description.p: This is a community package of MyGo Music, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream build unmodified.
MyGo Music is a native desktop music player written in Go, without a WebView. It plays your local files out of the box, and everything else comes from plugins.

ul.li: Local files (MP3, FLAC, Ogg Vorbis, WAV, ALAC and AAC) with tags, covers and .lrc lyrics.
Playlists, liked songs, search, albums and artists.
Now Playing with lyric styles, a cover wall, queue, shuffle and repeat.
Tray icon, media keys, audio cache, loudness normalization and session restore.
Podcast captions written down on the device as episodes play.
Plugins add accounts, catalogs, podcasts, stations and pages of their own.

description.p: The package can read your Music directory, play audio, expose media controls over MPRIS and show a tray icon, and it has network access for plugins and lyrics. Folders elsewhere can be added through the folder picker.

To have a folder outside Music read by its real path instead, grant it: flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/music:ro dev.egoist.music. Remove custom grants with flatpak override --user --reset dev.egoist.music.
Updates come through Flatpak. If the application says a new release is available, update with Flatpak instead; you can turn off its own update checks in Settings.
